profile.title: External AI diagnostic tool (vendor)
profile.needs: symptoms, vital signs, lab values and examination findings, plus work, travel and season context in the most general form that still supports the diagnosis
profile.receives: one de-identified note per request; the oversight agent chooses each field's setting (age, nationality, occupation, context, address) for this record
profile.never: name, Qatar ID, medical record number, date of birth, exact dates, phone, street address, names of relatives or clinicians; any combination of details shared by fewer than k_min people; any use of the data for training the vendor's models
profile.on_request: more detail only when the treating clinician asks for it, and only after a re-test (GW-HITL-03); a failed privacy test can be overridden only by the DPO with a legal basis (GW-HITL-04)

segments.t: The patient presents with painful swelling of one knee, fever, and inability to bear weight. The joint is warm with a large effusion and markedly restricted active and passive movement. Temperature is 38.3°C, heart rate 136/min, blood pressure 100/60 mmHg, and respiratory rate 27/min. Glucose is 27.5 mmol/L, venous pH 7.17, bicarbonate 9 mmol/L, and beta-hydroxybutyrate 6.3 mmol/L. White-cell count is 19.4 ×10⁹/L and C-reactive protein is 182 mg/L. Arthrocentesis yields cloudy fluid with 74,000 leukocytes/µL, but Gram stain is negative initially. There is no hypotension after fluids and no other focal source of infection.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Working diagnosis withheld for review. Admit / treat per protocol; senior review requested.
Attending:

data.weakest_point: The combination of exact age, sex, nationality, employer, occupation, and municipality—especially the rare employer–occupation pair—makes each note highly linkable even though direct identifiers are redacted.
strategies: Rare demographic and occupational profile scoring
